status: PASS: independent static plot API, implementation and test review; no production blocker found
production_checks: Entire final header/CPP and both tests read. Installed header/CPP/data tests are byte-identical to the stable staged sources read before installation. All63 accounting/reader/worker/DTO/old-test/fixture baseline files remain unchanged.

Factories bound presentation to24 hourly or7 daily scalar buckets. They select only download index3 and upload index1; no sums/rates/interpolation or new observations are computed. Null/mismatched snapshots yield unknown buckets for the validated selected identity. Week row and inner snapshot date consistency prevents mislabelled facts.

Frames copy scalar optionals and dates into private fixed storage and retain no caller snapshot or mutable alias. Shared immutable frame handles outlive source DTOs/widgets. Factories reject invalid dates/ranges; immutable frame constructors ensure valid fixed counts, preventing point divisor/count underflow.

Minimum/maximum include0 and both signed directions. Full signed-int64 extrema are converted before range subtraction. There is no signed subtraction/abs overflow, and invalid/nonfinite/degenerate rectangles or unknown/out-of-range buckets have no coordinates. Paint uses the same point helper.

Actual zero produces a real center-axis marker under a display-only -1..1 geometry, without adding unknown observations. All-unknown frames draw an explicit no-observations message and no colored sample trace. Only immediate known predecessor/current pairs connect, and every actual point has a marker.

Plot keeps byte-unit period/accessibility descriptions, exact signed decimal/UTC bucket tooltips, distinct blue solid versus orange dashed directions and sparse nonoverlapping tick labels. Fixed180..260 height preserves room for tables; narrow invalid chart areas return without unsafe coordinate use.

Setters guard factory/destructor reentry using QPointer plus prior frame identity, then replacement publishes one immutable token. Every direct accessibility/tooltip notification is followed by token/QPointer validation, so deletion or nested newer replacement prevents stale writes/update. Hover and QHelpEvent paths similarly stop before further object access after a notification changes ownership/frame.

Widget owns no child worker or external widget. No new IO, timer, thread, clock, network setting, accounting, history writer/cache or original-profile path exists. Hidden/minimized paint returns; View-level fact/tooltip/model deferral is separately reviewed.
